READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#343 @ af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477

Piece P2 of the payment sheet split of #334 (3 pieces: #342 -> #343 -> #344). Base `agent115/sheet-split-1-payment-core`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 1 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11) after backend recurring #678-#680 is deployed (OR-112-13 pair with #654).

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#343 @ af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477
- Lines: 2438 changed (source 1951 / tests 487 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 6 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts` 1120, `src/components/__tests__` 467, `src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx` 416, `src/components/purchase` 415, `src/config/__tests__` 20.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #334. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.
